_comment: Service slugs that get a page at COUNTY level: /kenya/<county>/<service>.
Shared deliberately between lib/seo/kenyaIndexable.ts (which builds the route's
generateStaticParams) and scripts/generate-kenya-guard.mjs (which writes the
inlined allowlist in middleware.ts). The middleware cannot import from @/lib —
a cross-module import fails open in the edge runtime — so its copy is generated
rather than imported. JSON is the one format both sides can read, which is why
this list lives here instead of in the TypeScript.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AT ALL. On 2026-08-01 guard 0b was tightened to an exact
allowlist built from the 10 'core' services. That correctly stopped Google
inventing junk URLs, but it also swept up every OTHER real service: 46 of the
56 defined in lib/data/seo-services.ts stopped being pages and started issuing
308s to the bare county page. Measured live 2026-09-03 across five counties:
190 of 240 service-county URLs redirected away, including ac-repair,
borehole-drilling and automatic-transfer-switch — and /kenya/nairobi, where
they land, never mentions air conditioning, boreholes or transfer switches.
SELECTION RULE: a slug earns a page if it names a DIFFERENT JOB OR PRODUCT.
Pure synonyms of an already-listed slug do not, because two pages competing on
the same intent is the duplication problem that started all of this.
DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED, and why:
repairs, maintenance, spareparts        bare synonyms of the generator-* slugs
generator-maintenance-companies         synonym of generator-maintenance
generator-changeover                    same job as automatic-transfer-switch
motor-rewinding-companies               synonym of motor-rewinding
solar-experts, solar-technicians        synonyms of solar-companies
power-backup                            synonym of ups-systems
solar-for-farms/hotels/hospitals/       audience variants of one service; they
industries/homes                      differ by who reads them, not what we do
These 14 stay out. Adding one back is a one-line change here — run
scripts/generate-kenya-guard.mjs afterwards or the build will fail.
CONSTITUENCY tier is NOT affected: it keeps the original 10 core services.
Constituency pages measured 68% identical to one another, and widening that
tier would rebuild the doorway problem withdrawn from the sitemap on 2026-08-15.
SITEMAP is NOT affected either. These pages are restored as pages — 200,
indexable, internally linked — which is exactly the state they were in through
June and July. The sitemap keeps submitting only the core set.
_excludedComment: Machine-readable so the guard generator can tell a SERVICE slug from a
CONSTITUENCY slug. Both appear as '<county>/<one segment>' in the allowlist,
and without this list the generator deleted 87 real constituency landing
pages (kajiado/kajiado-central and friends) on its first dry run.
A two-part key is only ever rewritten when its second segment is a known
service; everything else is preserved untouched.
